_about: SFX registry for storyboard cues. onset = seconds into the file where the hit/peak is (lands on the cue time). gain = default level (voice-relative, mix is loudnormed to -14 LUFS). status: ok | off (only if asked) | avoid.

whoosh.use: every change into stack/full layout, big wipes

click.use: About 6 per video, on real presses. Full gain on a visible press: cursor click, prompt submit (Enter), button tap. Softer (gain ~0.18) when an element lands on its word: focus_in / unblur_text text, a tag, a list item, a logo swap, a number locking in. At most ~1 per 1.5s, and never on top of a real clip that already has its own click sound.

riser.use: into a montage or big reveal — user removed it (v5); only if asked

typing.use: under on-screen typing (prompt boxes); set the cue's `dur` to the typing length. Source: Mixkit 'Typing on a laptop keyboard' #2531 (Mixkit free license), downloaded 2026-09-26

typing_fast.use: alt, faster typing. Source: Mixkit 'Fast laptop keyboard typing' #1392 (Mixkit free license), 2026-09-26
